timeline_events.summary: Caretaker coach Peter Taylor appoints David Beckham as England captain for the upcoming friendly against Italy.
David Beckham captained England from central midfield in a match against Italy, a role that raised questions about his effectiveness in that position.
Sven-Goran Eriksson reportedly said during a hoax call that he thought David Beckham would become captain of England.
Sven-Goran Eriksson confirms David Beckham will be England captain for the match against Spain.
David Beckham says he is ready to speak up as captain of England in Saturday's World Cup qualifier against Finland.
David Beckham returned to training with England after a groin injury ahead of the World Cup qualifier against Germany.

David Beckham says England's upcoming World Cup qualifier against Greece could be the proudest moment of his career, while urging a calm approach and noting the squad's strong spirit despite injuries to David Seaman and Michael Owen.
David Beckham injured a metatarsal before the 2002 World Cup, starting a trend of similar injuries among England footballers.
Internazionale president Massimo Moratti says the club was truly close to signing David Beckham last year, but the deal failed for a thousand reasons, and he now feels the prospects are impossible.
David Beckham was kicked on both ankles during a match against Holland, leaving him doubtful for Manchester United's Champions League game in Nantes.
David Beckham said he is ready to sign a new contract with Manchester United, though no deal is expected for a few weeks.

David Beckham returned to Manchester United with a heavily strapped left ankle and bandaged right shin after tests revealed no ligament or bone damage, though he was expected to miss the immediate match at Leicester.
Manchester United manager Sir Alex Ferguson says David Beckham could recover from his ankle injury in time for the Champions League return against Deportivo La Coruna next week.
A scan confirms David Beckham's ankle injury is only bad bruising, not a break, after he was stretchered off during a Champions League match.
Argentine press reacts to David Beckham's foot injury, with some hailing Aldo Duscher as a national hero amid uncertainty over whether Beckham will recover in time for the World Cup.
David Beckham broke a bone in his left foot during Manchester United's Champions League win over Deportivo La Coruna, casting doubt on his participation in the World Cup.

David Beckham's broken foot threatens England's World Cup hopes and disrupts major sponsors' World Cup merchandising plans, including Coca-Cola's limited edition bottles already in production and Pepsi's marketing campaign.
David Beckham is driven to Old Trafford to begin rehabilitation after breaking his second metatarsal bone, with experts disagreeing on whether he will recover in time for the World Cup.
David Beckham is expected to miss the World Cup due to injury, with England manager Sven-Goran Eriksson considering replacements.
David Beckham could earn £10m from sponsorship if England have a successful tournament and he features prominently in it.
Medical experts say David Beckham's broken second metatarsal bone in his left foot may not fully heal in eight weeks and could break again, with his recovery depending largely on luck.

David Beckham suffers a broken metatarsal, with recovery time uncertain and estimates ranging from under four weeks to six weeks, potentially affecting his participation in the World Cup and Manchester United's season.
Leading orthopaedic surgeons suggest David Beckham's metatarsal fracture may not have been caused by Aldo Duscher's tackle, possibly occurring before or after it.
David Beckham escaped unhurt after his car collided with a Ford Focus driven by an off-duty policeman near his home in Sawbridgeworth, Hertfordshire.
A Daily Mail report says David Beckham is behind schedule in his recovery from a metatarsal injury and is almost certain to miss England's World Cup opener against Sweden.

David Beckham continued his rehabilitation from a fractured metatarsal by striking the ball firmly with his left foot, with speculation that he may join full training later in the week ahead of England's World Cup opener against Sweden.
David Beckham signed a multi-million pound deal with HarperCollins to publish his first autobiography, scheduled for autumn 2003.
David Beckham's debut for Manchester United reaches its tenth anniversary.
David Beckham has broken a rib and will not play for three weeks.
David Beckham returns to the Manchester United squad for the Champions League game against Deportivo La Coruna after nearly a month out with a rib injury, though he may only be on the bench.

David Beckham reportedly needed two stitches in a head wound after being accidentally struck by a boot kicked by Sir Alex Ferguson following Manchester United's FA Cup defeat to Arsenal, though the club refused to confirm or deny the incident.

Real Madrid identified David Beckham as their top transfer target for the summer, with sporting director Jorge Valdano confirming the club chose him over Thierry Henry and Michael Owen for his marketing potential.
Speculation links David Beckham with a potential £40m transfer from Manchester United to Real Madrid, driven by his commercial value.
Real Madrid states no contact has existed with Manchester United or David Beckham and that it has no intention of negotiating his transfer, denying speculation linking Beckham with the club.
Manchester United confirmed that clubs from Italy and Spain have expressed firm interest in signing David Beckham, with sources indicating he may leave before the club's July tour.
David Beckham reluctantly accepts that his future may lie away from Manchester United, saying he is prepared to move if the club no longer wants him.

Manchester United accepts an undisclosed bid from Barcelona presidential candidate Joan Laporta for David Beckham, though Beckham is not seriously contemplating a move to Barcelona and would prefer AC Milan or Real Madrid.
Reports suggest David Beckham has signed a four-year contract with Real Madrid, though the deal is described as imminent if not concluded.
Manchester United agrees a £25m deal to transfer David Beckham to Real Madrid, after which Beckham and manager Sir Alex Ferguson exchange public tributes.
Manchester United resigned to accepting a lower transfer fee for David Beckham, with Real Madrid in a strong negotiating position as Beckham insists on joining them.
David Beckham agreed personal terms with Real Madrid well before the official announcement of his transfer from Manchester United.
Manchester United will receive as little as £7m this season from David Beckham's transfer to Real Madrid, with the basic £18m fee split into five tranches over four years.
Manchester United confirms David Beckham's transfer to Real Madrid for £24.5m, with the deal expected to be completed next month if satisfactory payment guarantees are agreed.
David Beckham apologised to his new Real Madrid team-mates for the publicity surrounding his transfer, saying he did not want it to detract from their final two games of the season.
David Beckham passed a medical examination, clearing the way for his £25m transfer from Manchester United to Real Madrid.
David Beckham scored his second league goal for Real Madrid with a curling shot in a 3-1 win at Malaga.
David Beckham announced he was parting company with SFX, the sports agency that arranged his move to Real Madrid, to focus on football and reduce commercial activities.
Manchester United chairman Sir Roy Gardner says selling David Beckham was "categorically" the right move and dismisses his performance as "not great."
David Beckham appeared at Buckingham Palace to collect the OBE, an honour criticised by some Labour MPs as being merely for his celebrity.
David Beckham says Real Madrid are still on course for a domestic and European treble despite losing the league leadership after a 1-0 defeat at Real Sociedad.
David Beckham is reported to have clinched a record-breaking £40m deal to become the new worldwide face of Gillette.
David Beckham drafts in football PR specialist Simon Oliveira as his new public relations manager ahead of England's Euro 2004 match against France.
David Beckham influenced England's tactical formation and contributed to their victory over Switzerland in a Euro 2004 match.
Vodafone says it may not renew David Beckham's sponsorship contract, previously estimated at £1 million a year, following his disappointing Euro 2004 performances.
Vodafone signed David Beckham to a year-long sponsorship deal worth more than £1m, obtaining rights to use his image for mobile phone content.
David Beckham admitted that lurid newspaper allegations about his private life, which he vehemently denies, affected his form for Real Madrid last season.
England captain David Beckham was criticised for his leadership after England lost their sense of direction against Austria.
David Beckham describes Steven Gerrard's injury as a "massive blow" for England ahead of their World Cup qualifier against Wales.

Real Madrid's income is expected to nearly double since 2002, with almost half coming directly from marketing, which the newspaper El País attributed to the signing of David Beckham revolutionising income through marketing.
A medical examination in Madrid reveals David Beckham will be out for only three or four weeks with two hairline rib fractures, rather than the initially feared six weeks.

The Football Association asks David Beckham to explain his deliberate booking in England's World Cup qualifier against Wales, giving him until Friday to respond before deciding on possible punitive measures.

The Football Association decided not to punish David Beckham over his admission that he deliberately got himself booked against Wales, concluding there was insufficient evidence to pursue a disciplinary charge.
David Beckham earned £1 million a month from UK sponsorship fees last year, with his company Footwork Productions declaring a turnover of £10.4 million for the final eight months of 2003.
David Beckham is set to make his feature film debut by playing himself in the Goal! trilogy.
A spokesman for David Beckham denied that the England captain was planning to retire from international football after the 2006 World Cup.
David Beckham stated he hopes to reach 100 caps for England and continue playing beyond the 2006 World Cup, denying reports he was considering retirement after the tournament.
David Beckham unveiled plans for his first international football academy near the Millennium Dome in Greenwich, south-east London, scheduled to open in the summer.
David Beckham launched the David Beckham Academy in Greenwich, pledging millions of pounds to fund children's football training.

England assistant manager Tord Grip says David Beckham will not be affected by latest revelations over his private life and confirms Beckham will captain the team for this summer's friendly against Colombia.
David Beckham's spokesman says reports that Beckham has agreed a Real Madrid contract extension are inaccurate, though both sides are keen to agree a new deal before the end of the year.
David Beckham is reportedly set to sign a contract extension with Real Madrid that would keep him at the club until 2009.
David Beckham stated he wants to finish his career at Real Madrid, with negotiations over a two-year contract extension scheduled to begin in September.
David Beckham is set to lead England for the 50th time as captain in a match against Argentina.

David Beckham states he intends to continue playing for another five years, provided he can keep playing Champions League football, and rejects reports that a back condition is threatening his career.
David Beckham defends Sir Alex Ferguson amid criticism and suggests Real Madrid should sign Roy Keane.
David Beckham rules out a move into football management after his playing career, saying he plans to focus on his youth academies, UNICEF work, and family.

A report by BBDO Consulting ranks David Beckham as the second most commercially valuable footballer in the world, with an estimated brand value of £31.5m, while noting his brand ranking is likely to drop significantly in coming years as he ages.
John Terry backs David Beckham to remain as England captain after the World Cup.
David Beckham may be about to enjoy a major tournament performance at the World Cup in Germany, and could be playing for his future as England captain over the next few weeks.
Motorola signed David Beckham as its global brand ambassador under a three-year deal.
David Beckham overcame severe dehydration and vomiting to score the goal that took England into the World Cup quarter-finals.
David Beckham announces he is stepping down as England captain following England's World Cup quarter-final exit.
David Beckham announced he would no longer serve as England captain.

David Beckham resigns as England captain, which a senior marketing executive says marks the beginning of the end of his height as a brand, though his existing sponsorship deals are unlikely to be affected.
David Beckham's representative denies reports that Beckham met Newcastle chairman Freddy Shepherd over a possible move back to the Premiership.
David Beckham was dropped from the England squad for the first time in 10 years by new head coach Steve McClaren.
Real Madrid assure David Beckham they want him to sign a contract extension to keep him at the club until 2009, with formal negotiations expected to begin the following month.
A spokesman for David Beckham denies reports that he has signed a new two-year contract with Real Madrid, confirming that formal talks are planned for September.
David Beckham said he will almost certainly never play in the Premiership again because he could not see himself playing against Manchester United.
Real Madrid are set to open formal talks with David Beckham's representatives over a contract extension.
Real Madrid sporting director Predrag Mijatovic warned that David Beckham may have to take a pay cut if he is to remain at the club, casting doubt on his future.
A spokesman for David Beckham rejects Real Madrid president Ramón Calderón's claim that Beckham is set to retire in two years.
David Beckham's £1m-a-year contract as the face of Police sunglasses was cancelled, amid being dropped from the England team and being edged towards the exit at Real Madrid.
The Los Angeles Galaxy confirmed their interest in signing David Beckham if he fails to agree a new contract with Real Madrid.

David Beckham flew to Italy for the wedding of Tom Cruise and Katie Holmes against the wishes of Real Madrid coach Fabio Capello, who said Beckham should stay in Spain for treatment on an injured knee.
David Beckham started in Real Madrid's 3-0 defeat to Recreativo de Huelva, their final match before the transfer window opened.
Gillette removed David Beckham from its celebrity roster of endorsers.
David Beckham will not leave Real Madrid during the January transfer window, with his future unlikely to be decided until later in the year.

Real Madrid sporting director Predrag Mijatovic says the club cannot wait much longer for David Beckham to decide on a new contract, while reports claim manager Fabio Capello has urged the club not to renew Beckham's deal.

Real Madrid sporting director Predrag Mijatovic reportedly said David Beckham's contract would not be renewed, but later claimed his comments were lost in translation, leaving Beckham's future at the club unclear.
David Beckham confirmed he will join the LA Galaxy on a five-year deal at the end of his Real Madrid contract this summer.
LA Galaxy general manager Alexi Lalas insists the club will not try to negotiate an early departure from Real Madrid for David Beckham and expects to welcome him in the summer.
David Beckham and Gillette are to part company after failing to reach agreement over a one-year extension of the footballer's sponsorship contract.
David Beckham returned to England's national team after 335 days, providing an exceptional free-kick delivery that led to John Terry's goal in a 1-1 draw against Brazil at the new Wembley.
Former England manager Glenn Hoddle says David Beckham can play at the highest level for six more years, and Beckham's move to Los Angeles Galaxy should not impair his international chances.
David Beckham was unveiled as a Major League Soccer player after signing a five-year deal with the LA Galaxy.
David Beckham's ankle ligament injury puts his Los Angeles Galaxy debut against Chelsea in doubt.
LA Galaxy's owners plan to exploit David Beckham's revenue-gathering ability through a series of overseas tours, with England and Asia the most likely destinations.
David Beckham made his LA Galaxy debut, playing 13 minutes in a match against Chelsea.
David Beckham is likely to make his Major League Soccer debut for Los Angeles Galaxy against Toronto FC.
David Beckham suffered a knee injury while playing for LA Galaxy in the SuperLiga final, potentially ruling him out of England's upcoming Euro 2008 qualifiers.
John Terry says he will concede the England captaincy to David Beckham if it helps the national team under new manager Fabio Capello.
Gillette replaced David Beckham with Thierry Henry, Tiger Woods and Roger Federer for its first advertising campaign since parting company with Beckham last year.
David Beckham says he will not retire from international football and hopes to reach 100 caps for England and continue playing through the 2010 World Cup.
David Beckham is recalled to the England squad by manager Fabio Capello, putting him in line to earn his 100th cap in the friendly against France in Paris.
David Beckham made his 100th appearance for England in a friendly international against France at the Stade de France in Paris.
David Beckham's Los Angeles Galaxy lose 4-0 to Colorado Rapids in their Major League Soccer season opener, spoiling Ruud Gullit's coaching debut.
David Beckham has been named England captain for Sunday's friendly against Trinidad and Tobago.
David Beckham urges Cristiano Ronaldo to reject Real Madrid and stay at Manchester United.
LA Galaxy acknowledged discussions took place regarding a possible loan switch for David Beckham to Milan in the January transfer window, though coach Bruce Arena questioned the idea.

AC Milan president Adriano Galliani says the club would have no problem if David Beckham wished to train with them after his Los Angeles Galaxy season ends, amid reports the invitation could precede a formal transfer bid.

The MLS confirms that discussions have taken place between AC Milan and the LA Galaxy regarding a possible short-term loan for David Beckham during the MLS off-season, though LA Galaxy manager Bruce Arena questions the proposed deal.

AC Milan coach Carlo Ancelotti says he would welcome a permanent move for loan-target David Beckham, with the club in talks to bring the Los Angeles Galaxy midfielder to the San Siro on a three-month loan in January.
AC Milan confirmed the loan signing of David Beckham, who will join the club on January 7, 2009.
David Beckham is set to arrive at Milan in January, though his precise role at the club remains to be determined.

Milan players Clarence Seedorf and Ronaldinho give contrasting reactions to David Beckham's imminent loan arrival at the San Siro, with Seedorf doubting whether Beckham will ever play for Milan and Ronaldinho expressing happiness about the deal.
David Beckham received a lukewarm welcome at his unveiling at San Siro after signing a deal with Milan.
David Beckham scored his first goal for Milan.
David Beckham joins AC Milan on loan, a move that raises doubts about whether he will earn further England caps.
David Beckham made his debut for AC Milan, playing the first 45 minutes of a 1-1 friendly draw with Hamburg in Dubai.
Former LA Galaxy general manager Alexi Lalas expresses fear that David Beckham may leave the US for good, while Beckham's spokesman insists he will return to the Galaxy in March.
David Beckham made his Serie A debut for Milan, playing almost the entire match in a 2-2 draw away at Roma.
AC Milan vice-president Adriano Galliani says the club plans to meet David Beckham's agents to explore signing him permanently from the Los Angeles Galaxy.
England head coach Fabio Capello hints that David Beckham's performances at Milan could earn him a place in the England squad for the 11 February friendly against Spain.
David Beckham scored a trademark free-kick for Milan in a 1–1 draw against Genoa before being substituted with an abductor injury.
David Beckham's lawyers are in talks with the Los Angeles Galaxy over extending his stay at Milan, with Beckham having made clear he wants to remain in Italy.
MLS commissioner Don Garber sets a Friday deadline for Milan to agree a deal to sign David Beckham from Los Angeles Galaxy.
David Beckham equalled Bobby Moore's record of 108 England caps for an outfield player by coming on as a half-time substitute in a 2-0 friendly defeat to Spain in Seville.

David Beckham's transfer from Los Angeles Galaxy to AC Milan appeared dead after Milan failed to meet the deadline imposed by Major League Soccer Commissioner Don Garber, with Galaxy saying Beckham will return once his loan spell ends next month.
David Beckham admitted it would be difficult to return to LA Galaxy after his loan spell at Milan ends, saying he wants to stay but his future is out of his hands.
AC Milan vice president Adriano Galliani insists he will not raise the club's $3m offer for David Beckham, despite Beckham's desire to remain in Serie A.
Milan chief executive Adriano Galliani says the club remains intent on extending David Beckham's loan from Los Angeles Galaxy until the end of June, with a view to signing him permanently next year.
Milan deny reaching an agreement with Los Angeles Galaxy to keep David Beckham beyond his short-term loan, which ends on 9 March, while working on a possible loan extension until 30 June.

David Beckham agrees a "timeshare" deal between Los Angeles Galaxy and Milan to remain at Milan until the end of the Serie A campaign, then return to the US for part of the MLS season before rejoining Milan on loan.

David Beckham confirmed a deal had been agreed with the Los Angeles Galaxy to extend his loan contract at Milan until the end of the Serie A season, in order to pursue his goal of playing for England at the 2010 World Cup.
David Beckham agrees to extend his short-term loan from LA Galaxy to Milan until the end of the Serie A season, with a clause allowing him to leave Galaxy in November.
The FA stated that England coach Fabio Capello has no plans to make a special exemption or deal with LA Galaxy regarding the release of David Beckham for the August friendly against Holland.

David Beckham says he expects criticism from Los Angeles Galaxy fans when he returns to the club in July under a timeshare agreement, after stating he wants to stay at AC Milan to boost his chances of playing in the 2010 World Cup.
David Beckham says his loan spell at Milan has improved his fitness and helped prolong his England career, ahead of potentially making his 109th appearance against Slovakia.
David Beckham says he will never retire from international football as he prepares to break Bobby Moore's England outfield record of 108 caps by appearing in a friendly against Slovakia.
David Beckham announces he will leave Los Angeles Galaxy in December to secure a transfer back to Europe, with Milan his first-choice destination and a return to the Premier League not ruled out.
David Beckham says he is open to a possible return to the Premier League and would no longer rule out playing for an English club other than Manchester United.
David Beckham warns LA Galaxy he will go on loan again to maintain his hopes of representing England at the 2010 World Cup finals.

David Beckham was subjected to fierce abuse from a vocal section of LA Galaxy supporters during a friendly against Milan, prompting him to approach the LA Riot Squad at half-time before security ushered him away.
David Beckham stars in the MLS Cup Final.

David Beckham met with FIFA president Sepp Blatter and other executive committee members in Cape Town to support England's bid to host the 2018 World Cup, hours after learning of his grandfather's death.
Landon Donovan says he was wrong to criticise David Beckham as a poor leader and team-mate at LA Galaxy and believes Beckham's form will warrant a place in England's World Cup squad.

David Beckham said he has forgiven Sir Alex Ferguson for the 2003 'boot-rage' incident, has no scores to settle with Manchester United, and would not celebrate if he scored against them ahead of Milan's Champions League match.
David Beckham ruptured his achilles tendon while playing for Milan against Chievo, an injury that ruled him out for the season and cast doubt on his participation in the 2010 World Cup.
David Beckham underwent successful surgery in Finland for a ruptured achilles tendon suffered while playing for Milan, an injury expected to rule him out of the 2010 World Cup.
David Beckham ruptured an achilles tendon late in his career, prompting discussion about his role in England's 2010 World Cup squad.
David Beckham confirms he hopes to join England's coaching staff for the World Cup after Fabio Capello offered him a role, though his participation depends on how his injury rehabilitation proceeds.

England coach Fabio Capello said in a televised interview that David Beckham is "a little bit old" to win another competitive cap, effectively ending Beckham's England career, though Beckham's agent said there had been no discussion of retirement and he would remain available for his country.

Tottenham Hotspur await a response from Los Angeles Galaxy over a proposed loan move for David Beckham, with no face-to-face discussions having taken place and Galaxy yet to indicate whether they will allow the loan.
David Beckham was prevented from playing for Tottenham Hotspur in a behind-closed-doors friendly against Queens Park Rangers due to an insurance issue.

David Beckham's representatives plan to negotiate a permanent move away from LA Galaxy to a European club, preferably a Premier League club competing in the Champions League, when his contract ends in the summer.
Paris Saint-Germain's Leonardo says he would always consider David Beckham, calling him more than a football player.
David Beckham played what was likely his final competitive game for LA Galaxy, contributing to the goal in their 1-0 MLS Cup final win over Houston.
David Beckham will not be joining Paris St-Germain, with the club's sporting director confirming the deal is over and Beckham instead almost certain to sign a new two-year deal with LA Galaxy.
David Beckham's return to LA Galaxy has been delayed as the two sides continue to negotiate his contract, though his representatives remain confident he will sign.
David Beckham revealed he turned down offers from Premier League clubs before agreeing to sign a two-year deal to stay with LA Galaxy.
David Beckham announced that his last game for LA Galaxy will be the MLS Cup final against Houston Dynamo on 1 December, ending his five-year spell with the club.
David Beckham's career from Manchester United to LA Galaxy is reviewed in a video, noting he will leave LA Galaxy after playing in his second straight MLS Cup final on 1 December.
David Beckham is leaving the LA Galaxy, with his final competitive game for the club being the MLS Cup final against the Houston Dynamo.
David Beckham played his final game for LA Galaxy, winning his second successive MLS Cup with a 3-1 victory over Houston Dynamo.
David Beckham ends his LA Galaxy career by winning the MLS Cup.
David Beckham announced at a Paris Saint-Germain press conference that he would not receive any salary, donating it instead to a children's charity.
David Beckham is set to join Paris Saint-Germain, with his arrival at the club expected on Thursday afternoon.
David Beckham trains with Paris Saint-Germain for the first time.
David Beckham made his debut for Paris Saint-Germain, coming off the bench in the 76th minute and setting up Zlatan Ibrahimovic for the second goal against Marseille.
David Beckham hinted he would like an ambassadorial role with the FA after retiring, while stating he has no plans to retire and will continue playing.
David Beckham won the French league title with Paris Saint-Germain after their 1-0 win at Lyon, his fourth league title in a fourth country.

Following his retirement, David Beckham could return to Los Angeles Galaxy as an MLS owner, with options including a partnership in a buyout of AEG at the club or starting a franchise in a new territory such as Miami.
David Beckham is to retire from football after two decades.
Manchester United invited David Beckham's 14-year-old son Brooklyn to train at their academy, with further sessions planned before deciding whether to offer him a place.
David Beckham confirmed his intention to buy in as an MLS owner in Miami at a press conference, though the team still faces stadium problems.

David Beckham's Miami Beckham United group presented a vision for a proposed 25,000-seat waterfront stadium at PortMiami for a new MLS team, but the group has not secured the site and faces obstacles.
Miami-Dade Mayor Carlos Gimenez urged David Beckham’s MLS stadium investment group to consider an alternative downtown waterfront site instead of the Port of Miami.

Miami mayor Tomás Regalado vetoed a waterfront stadium site for David Beckham's planned Major League Soccer franchise, the second rejection of a stadium proposal in a month, prompting Beckham's investment group to pause and weigh alternatives.

Miami-Dade county commissioners unanimously vote to open negotiations with Florida International University over a temporary ground-sharing arrangement for David Beckham's proposed Major League Soccer franchise while a permanent stadium site is sought.
David Beckham's Miami MLS franchise remains without a stadium, name, colours or management more than a year after the franchise was announced, with two stadium site options having failed.
David Beckham's partners reached an initial agreement with Miami officials to build a privately funded 25,000-seat MLS stadium on the former Orange Bowl site.
David Beckham announced his investment group secured a stadium development site in Miami's Overtown district for his MLS club.
David Beckham's Miami Beckham United group secured an agreed-upon stadium site in the Overtown district for a planned MLS expansion franchise, with MLS owners approving the location over the weekend.
David Beckham's Miami football club, Miami Beckham United, is in talks with Paris Saint-Germain about the sale of an equity stake.
David Beckham confirmed he would leave Real Madrid to sign with the Los Angeles Galaxy, marking 10 years since the announcement.
The Miami-Dade Commission voted to approve the sale of nearly three acres of county land to David Beckham's group for a planned 25,000-seat Major League Soccer stadium in Miami.
David Beckham is currently sidelined with a ruptured achilles tendon, described as a really bad injury that is hard to recover from.
David Beckham says the new Miami MLS franchise will bring in great players.

facts.text: On 2002-04-10, David Beckham broke a bone in his left foot during Manchester United's Champions League win over Deportivo La Coruna, casting doubt on his World Cup participation.
On 2003-06-17, David Beckham agreed personal terms with Real Madrid well before the official announcement of his transfer from Manchester United.
On 2003-10-14, David Beckham announced he was parting company with SFX, the sports agency that arranged his move to Real Madrid, to focus on football and reduce commercial activities.
On 2004-01-11, David Beckham said Real Madrid were still on course for a domestic and European treble despite losing the league leadership after a 1-0 defeat at Real Sociedad.
On 2005-11-12, David Beckham was set to lead England for the 50th time as captain in a match against Argentina.
On 2006-07-01, David Beckham announced he was stepping down as England captain following England's World Cup quarter-final exit.
On 2006-08-11, David Beckham was dropped from the England squad for the first time in 10 years by new head coach Steve McClaren.
On 2007-01-11, David Beckham confirmed he will join the LA Galaxy on a five-year deal at the end of his Real Madrid contract this summer.

event-e4dde256d96bb6fe.summary: David Beckham says his loan spell at Milan has improved his fitness and helped prolong his England career, ahead of potentially making his 109th appearance against Slovakia.

event-0101b82c635dbd98.summary: David Beckham says he will never retire from international football as he prepares to break Bobby Moore's England outfield record of 108 caps by appearing in a friendly against Slovakia.

event-05bb20d7bdc097f0.summary: David Beckham announces he will leave Los Angeles Galaxy in December to secure a transfer back to Europe, with Milan his first-choice destination and a return to the Premier League not ruled out.

event-f7e8e0df15a583d7.summary: David Beckham says he is open to a possible return to the Premier League and would no longer rule out playing for an English club other than Manchester United.

event-8364712fa1e333f5.summary: David Beckham warns LA Galaxy he will go on loan again to maintain his hopes of representing England at the 2010 World Cup finals.

event-6623027af605cd6e.summary: David Beckham was subjected to fierce abuse from a vocal section of LA Galaxy supporters during a friendly against Milan, prompting him to approach the LA Riot Squad at half-time before security ushered him away.

event-970d4eb7f58df9fe.summary: David Beckham stars in the MLS Cup Final.

event-5a9caf84be615140.summary: David Beckham met with FIFA president Sepp Blatter and other executive committee members in Cape Town to support England's bid to host the 2018 World Cup, hours after learning of his grandfather's death.

event-f203300eaac320c9.summary: Landon Donovan says he was wrong to criticise David Beckham as a poor leader and team-mate at LA Galaxy and believes Beckham's form will warrant a place in England's World Cup squad.

event-337dc062b44bc5d3.summary: David Beckham said he has forgiven Sir Alex Ferguson for the 2003 'boot-rage' incident, has no scores to settle with Manchester United, and would not celebrate if he scored against them ahead of Milan's Champions League match.

event-1c86798c9e264dac.summary: David Beckham ruptured his achilles tendon while playing for Milan against Chievo, an injury that ruled him out for the season and cast doubt on his participation in the 2010 World Cup.

event-8cd57c53e08d20c0.summary: David Beckham underwent successful surgery in Finland for a ruptured achilles tendon suffered while playing for Milan, an injury expected to rule him out of the 2010 World Cup.

event-7cd87e9773cc9a35.summary: David Beckham ruptured an achilles tendon late in his career, prompting discussion about his role in England's 2010 World Cup squad.

event-4724f1fdd298c345.summary: David Beckham confirms he hopes to join England's coaching staff for the World Cup after Fabio Capello offered him a role, though his participation depends on how his injury rehabilitation proceeds.

event-d9095ec582070cc6.summary: England coach Fabio Capello said in a televised interview that David Beckham is "a little bit old" to win another competitive cap, effectively ending Beckham's England career, though Beckham's agent said there had been no discussion of retirement and he would remain available for his country.

event-bc0cc12353bd4bef.summary: Tottenham Hotspur await a response from Los Angeles Galaxy over a proposed loan move for David Beckham, with no face-to-face discussions having taken place and Galaxy yet to indicate whether they will allow the loan.

event-29567b6cdbadbfd2.summary: David Beckham was prevented from playing for Tottenham Hotspur in a behind-closed-doors friendly against Queens Park Rangers due to an insurance issue.

event-230bac1f08c1eaac.summary: David Beckham's representatives plan to negotiate a permanent move away from LA Galaxy to a European club, preferably a Premier League club competing in the Champions League, when his contract ends in the summer.

event-835bf65c5fc9b981.summary: Paris Saint-Germain's Leonardo says he would always consider David Beckham, calling him more than a football player.

event-88c8e9f946114bf7.summary: David Beckham played what was likely his final competitive game for LA Galaxy, contributing to the goal in their 1-0 MLS Cup final win over Houston.

event-5c88a0609ab7b21c.summary: David Beckham will not be joining Paris St-Germain, with the club's sporting director confirming the deal is over and Beckham instead almost certain to sign a new two-year deal with LA Galaxy.

event-f44c805f037f6488.summary: David Beckham's return to LA Galaxy has been delayed as the two sides continue to negotiate his contract, though his representatives remain confident he will sign.

event-9a566a5633604d99.summary: David Beckham revealed he turned down offers from Premier League clubs before agreeing to sign a two-year deal to stay with LA Galaxy.

event-b0d4685016f29668.summary: David Beckham announced that his last game for LA Galaxy will be the MLS Cup final against Houston Dynamo on 1 December, ending his five-year spell with the club.

event-54256cdaf81c8086.summary: David Beckham's career from Manchester United to LA Galaxy is reviewed in a video, noting he will leave LA Galaxy after playing in his second straight MLS Cup final on 1 December.

event-daf255bb4d4a7ee3.summary: David Beckham is leaving the LA Galaxy, with his final competitive game for the club being the MLS Cup final against the Houston Dynamo.

event-bd812e0d568e268a.summary: David Beckham played his final game for LA Galaxy, winning his second successive MLS Cup with a 3-1 victory over Houston Dynamo.

event-8b44abd98d66f864.summary: David Beckham ends his LA Galaxy career by winning the MLS Cup.

event-4e98c5d8b3352d34.summary: David Beckham announced at a Paris Saint-Germain press conference that he would not receive any salary, donating it instead to a children's charity.

event-8efcccd2efa675fe.summary: David Beckham is set to join Paris Saint-Germain, with his arrival at the club expected on Thursday afternoon.

event-24213887c3d933a7.summary: David Beckham trains with Paris Saint-Germain for the first time.

event-a32ee3bb2dba707f.summary: David Beckham made his debut for Paris Saint-Germain, coming off the bench in the 76th minute and setting up Zlatan Ibrahimovic for the second goal against Marseille.

event-9fdd2dcbc74c5e6e.summary: David Beckham hinted he would like an ambassadorial role with the FA after retiring, while stating he has no plans to retire and will continue playing.

event-37bab97b32692b2e.summary: David Beckham won the French league title with Paris Saint-Germain after their 1-0 win at Lyon, his fourth league title in a fourth country.

event-ea3a5cedf1c2347e.summary: Following his retirement, David Beckham could return to Los Angeles Galaxy as an MLS owner, with options including a partnership in a buyout of AEG at the club or starting a franchise in a new territory such as Miami.

event-f674cf548f10e2e1.summary: David Beckham is to retire from football after two decades.

event-bedc5cc3ce328e99.summary: Manchester United invited David Beckham's 14-year-old son Brooklyn to train at their academy, with further sessions planned before deciding whether to offer him a place.

event-6e79cc600d35ab94.summary: David Beckham confirmed his intention to buy in as an MLS owner in Miami at a press conference, though the team still faces stadium problems.

event-62bd3a040485d2bb.summary: David Beckham's Miami Beckham United group presented a vision for a proposed 25,000-seat waterfront stadium at PortMiami for a new MLS team, but the group has not secured the site and faces obstacles.

event-a34107a1c5766de6.summary: Miami-Dade Mayor Carlos Gimenez urged David Beckham’s MLS stadium investment group to consider an alternative downtown waterfront site instead of the Port of Miami.

event-4b37c746ffe410bf.summary: Miami mayor Tomás Regalado vetoed a waterfront stadium site for David Beckham's planned Major League Soccer franchise, the second rejection of a stadium proposal in a month, prompting Beckham's investment group to pause and weigh alternatives.

event-5b2db714913fb041.summary: Miami-Dade county commissioners unanimously vote to open negotiations with Florida International University over a temporary ground-sharing arrangement for David Beckham's proposed Major League Soccer franchise while a permanent stadium site is sought.

event-e00c51763248277a.summary: David Beckham's Miami MLS franchise remains without a stadium, name, colours or management more than a year after the franchise was announced, with two stadium site options having failed.

event-8216b23961c468d7.summary: David Beckham's partners reached an initial agreement with Miami officials to build a privately funded 25,000-seat MLS stadium on the former Orange Bowl site.

event-f6723e22552afe59.summary: David Beckham announced his investment group secured a stadium development site in Miami's Overtown district for his MLS club.

event-63a7cc71c37bb997.summary: David Beckham's Miami Beckham United group secured an agreed-upon stadium site in the Overtown district for a planned MLS expansion franchise, with MLS owners approving the location over the weekend.

event-c7d4644ca0ecbbfa.summary: David Beckham's Miami football club, Miami Beckham United, is in talks with Paris Saint-Germain about the sale of an equity stake.

event-a877924814323ed6.summary: David Beckham confirmed he would leave Real Madrid to sign with the Los Angeles Galaxy, marking 10 years since the announcement.

event-f5e1e1708d15558a.summary: The Miami-Dade Commission voted to approve the sale of nearly three acres of county land to David Beckham's group for a planned 25,000-seat Major League Soccer stadium in Miami.

event-82dc376c5cbda539.summary: David Beckham is currently sidelined with a ruptured achilles tendon, described as a really bad injury that is hard to recover from.

event-8a0e1c97196a8c6a.summary: David Beckham says the new Miami MLS franchise will bring in great players.

On 2004-10-21, the FA decided not to punish David Beckham over his admission that he deliberately got himself booked against Wales, citing insufficient evidence for a disciplinary charge.

On 2006-07-01, David Beckham announced he was stepping down as England captain following England's World Cup quarter-final exit; on 2006-08-11 he was dropped from the England squad for the first time in 10 years by new head coach Steve McClaren.
On 2007-01-11, David Beckham confirmed he will join the LA Galaxy on a five-year deal at the end of his Real Madrid contract this summer.
On 2008-03-20, David Beckham was recalled to the England squad by manager Fabio Capello, putting him in line to earn his 100th cap in the friendly against France in Paris.

On 2009-01-02, David Beckham joined AC Milan on loan, a move that raised doubts about whether he would earn further England caps; on 2009-01-28 he scored a trademark free-kick for Milan in a 1-1 draw against Genoa before being substituted with an abductor injury.
